verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because a compliance automation platform could plausibly offer a public API for custom evidence integrations. The evidence, however, shows only auditor-vetted native integrations and an MCP server that lets an AI assistant add comments, attachments and status updates to evidence requests. That assistant-facing interface is an adjacent feature, not a documented developer API for building custom integrations that push evidence or test results from uncovered systems. No REST API, SDK, custom-integration framework or API reference appears in the pack.
